CHARACTER_NAME_COMMENT: Must match a GobboNet character card's name (case-insensitive) for this profile to auto-load.
SPRITE_SHEET_COMMENT: Filename of this profile's sprite sheet PNG, expected alongside this json in the profiles folder.
SPRITE_WIDTH_COMMENT: Final on-screen sprite width in pixels, after scaling.
SPRITE_HEIGHT_COMMENT: Final on-screen sprite height in pixels, after scaling.
ROWS_COMMENT: Number of rows in the sprite sheet grid.
COLS_COMMENT: Number of columns in the sprite sheet grid.
BUBBLE_OFFSET_X_COMMENT: Shifts the speech bubble (and its triangle) left/right relative to the sprite, in pixels. 0 keeps it centered above the sprite as usual; positive moves it right, negative moves it left. Handy for left/right-facing sprites or ones with empty space on one side.
BUBBLE_OFFSET_Y_COMMENT: Shifts the speech bubble (and its triangle) up/down relative to the sprite, in pixels. 0 is the normal position just above the sprite; positive moves it down (closer to/over the sprite), negative moves it further up.
EMOTIONS_COMMENT: List of [tag, row, col] entries. It's fine to list the same tag more than once with different coordinates -- one is picked at random each time that emotion is shown.
GARDEN_COMMENT: This character's list of proactive prompts (the 'garden'). A line is chosen at random each time.

PROACTIVE_TEMPLATE_COMMENT: Format string for accessibility data sent to the model for this character. {app_name}, {what}, {summary}, {prompt} are substituted.
proactive_template:
I'm using '{app_name}', looking at '{what}'. The page shows things like ['{summary}']. 

{prompt}
PROACTIVE_CHECK_PERIOD_MIN_COMMENT: Minimum seconds between proactive opportunities for this character. Leave null to use the global default.
PROACTIVE_CHECK_PERIOD_MAX_COMMENT: Maximum seconds between proactive opportunities for this character. Leave null to use the global default.
PROACTIVE_PROBABILITY_COMMENT: Chance (0-1) that a proactive opportunity actually triggers for this character. Leave null to use the global default.
